description: This Java source file is an Android application component that demonstrates text measurement and rendering using the Android graphics framework. It contains a `MeasureText` activity with an inner class `SampleView` that draws text on a canvas, measures text dimensions, and visualizes text metrics.

classes.name: MeasureText
classes.description: An Android activity that renders and demonstrates measurement of text using the Canvas API.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View subclass that handles drawing text and associated graphics to illustrate text measurement and layout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting the content view to an instance of the nested SampleView class.

methods.name: createColors
methods.description: Generates a color matrix for bitmap creation (not directly used in rendering).

methods.name: showText
methods.description: Measures and draws text along with its bounding box and baseline, illustrating text measurement metrics.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles drawing the layout, invoking showText for different alignments.
